title: Typewriter
description: A sentence that types itself, deletes itself, and types the next one — with a patient caret.
usage: Phrases live in the data-phrases attribute as a JSON list. The rhythm is the design: type at reading-aloud speed, rest on the finished line, delete faster than you typed. One typewriter per page — two is a typing pool.
a11y: The animation is a performance of text that must also exist statically: the element carries an aria-label with the full sentence, the animated text is aria-hidden, and under prefers-reduced-motion the first phrase simply stands typed. Never put information only in a later phrase.
